The '''Krikthasi Massacre''' occurred when the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dakron]] visited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Baralou]], homeworld of the [[Krikthasi]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Darkon wished to learn about Krikthasi history, but when the [[Species/Legends|species]] refused the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] destroyed their capital city.<ref name="TOR:ToO" />
